soft + fluid systems

What it is

Static comp: frosted-glass testimonial card ('MerchFarm', scalloped badge with interlocking-rings logo, quote) floating over a soft fluid gradient field - orange/violet blobs with faint topographic contour rings and fine halftone grain.

Media

Frame-by-frame

image
Square comp: dreamy fluid background (large soft orange and purple blobs, blue-lavender base, thin white contour circles upper-left and right edges, halftone dot texture). Centered vertical glass card: MerchFarm logo row, large scalloped seal containing two interlocking rings, and a 3-line quote 'Scaled without extra staff. Bocobay cut costs and grew 75 properties with Conduit.'

Build prompt

Rebuild this static comp 1:1, pixel-faithful: a frosted-glass testimonial card floating over a soft fluid gradient field - orange and violet blobs on a blue-lavender base, thin topographic contour rings at the edges, fine halftone grain over everything.

## Stack
React + TypeScript + Tailwind. Background as layered radial gradients + SVG contour circles + an overlay grain texture (or one prepared raster). Glass card via backdrop-blur. No animation required.

## Scene
Square comp. Background: large soft orange and purple blurred blobs over a blue-lavender base; thin white contour circles creeping in from the upper-left and right edges; uniform halftone dot texture on top. Center: vertical frosted card (white/15, backdrop-blur 20px, 1px white/25 border, radius 20) holding the "MerchFarm" logo row, a large scalloped seal containing two interlocking rings, and a 3-line quote: "Scaled without extra staff. Bocobay cut costs and grew 75 properties with Conduit."

## Motion spec
None. The background reads as liquid but is a still. At most an ultra-slow 60s blob drift if you must animate - default is static.

## Calibration
- The glass card must genuinely blur the field behind it (backdrop-filter), not fake it with a translucent fill.
- Contour rings are hairline (1px), low opacity, cropped by the comp edges.
- Grain is uniform and fine - visible at 100%, invisible at arm's length.

## Reduced motion
N/A - static comp.

## Don't miss
- The scalloped seal with interlocking rings is the focal artifact - build it as SVG, not an image placeholder.
- Quote type is the second focal: large, tight tracking, balanced ragged-right over 3 lines.
- Blobs bleed off the comp edges; contained blobs look like stickers.
